title: Data Management & Retrieval
summary: This module provides comprehensive functionalities for loading, indexing, storing, and retrieving documents. It encompasses tools for ingesting data from various sources, managing vector stores and document indexes, and implementing diverse retrieval strategies to efficiently access relevant information.

nodes.label: Raw Data Sources
nodes.title: Raw Data Sources
nodes.description: External data sources like files, APIs, or databases that provide unstructured or semi-structured content for ingestion.

nodes.label: Load & Parse Raw Data
nodes.title: Document Loader
nodes.description: Components responsible for ingesting raw data from various sources and converting it into a standardized Document object format.

nodes.label: Standardized Document Object
nodes.title: Document Object
nodes.description: The core data structure representing a piece of text content along with its associated metadata, used throughout the system.

nodes.label: Split Documents into Chunks
nodes.title: Text Splitter
nodes.description: Utility that breaks down large documents into smaller, manageable chunks, optimizing them for embedding and retrieval processes.

nodes.label: Generate Vector Embeddings
nodes.title: Embedding Model
nodes.description: External service or model that converts text chunks into numerical vector representations, crucial for semantic similarity search.

nodes.label: Index Documents & Metadata
nodes.title: Document Indexer
nodes.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of documents and their associated metadata, often supporting full-text search or ID-based lookup.

nodes.label: Store Vector Embeddings
nodes.title: Vector Store
nodes.description: A specialized database designed to store and efficiently query vector embeddings, enabling fast similarity searches.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Index Creation
nodes.title: Index Creator
nodes.description: A utility that automates the end-to-end process of creating a document or vector index, from loading to embedding and storage.

nodes.label: User Query Input
nodes.title: User Query Input
nodes.description: The natural language query or structured request provided by the user to initiate the information retrieval process.

nodes.label: Apply Retrieval Strategies
nodes.title: Retrieval Strategies
nodes.description: Implements various techniques (e.g., multi-query, ensemble, self-query) to fetch relevant documents or examples from indexes and vector stores.

nodes.label: Refine & Filter Documents
nodes.title: Document Refiner
nodes.description: Components that process initially retrieved documents, performing tasks like extraction, filtering, compression, or reranking to improve relevance and quality.

nodes.label: Select Examples for Prompts
nodes.title: Example Selector
nodes.description: Chooses a subset of relevant examples from a collection based on criteria like semantic similarity or maximal marginal relevance, for few-shot prompting.

nodes.label: LLM for Query/Refinement
nodes.title: LLM for Query/Refinement
nodes.description: A Large Language Model used to assist in retrieval tasks, such as generating multiple queries, structuring queries, or refining retrieved content.

nodes.label: Retrieved & Processed Output
nodes.title: Final Output
nodes.description: The ultimate result of the data management and retrieval pipeline, consisting of refined documents or selected examples ready for consumption.

groups.label: Data Ingestion
groups.title: Data Ingestion
groups.description: Handles loading raw data from various external sources and converting it into a standardized document format for internal processing.

groups.label: Document Processing & Indexing
groups.title: Document Processing & Indexing
groups.description: Prepares documents for efficient retrieval by splitting them into chunks, generating vector embeddings, and storing them in specialized indexes or vector databases.

groups.label: Query & Retrieval Execution
groups.title: Query & Retrieval Execution
groups.description: Processes user queries, potentially enhancing them with LLMs, and executes various retrieval strategies against the indexed data to fetch relevant information.

groups.label: Result Refinement & Output
groups.title: Result Refinement & Output
groups.description: Post-processes the retrieved information by refining, filtering, or selecting examples, ultimately preparing the final output for the user or downstream applications.
